user.title: Crow Messenger
user.description: Set up Crow Messenger. There's nothing to fill in — add the Crow Messenger card to a dashboard, then open the card editor to choose each person's dashboard, notifications and how long messages are kept.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Send a Crow Messenger message to one or more Home Assistant users.

to.name: To
to.description: Home Assistant user IDs or names to send to. More than one makes a group chat.

attachment.name: Attachment
attachment.description: Optional file to attach: a path inside an allowed folder (e.g. /config/www/doorbell.jpg) or a /local/… URL.

group_name.name: Group name
group_name.description: Optional name for the group chat when sending to more than one person.

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Optional buttons under the message, e.g. ["Unlock", "Ignore"] or [{"title": "Unlock", "action": "UNLOCK_DOOR"}]. Tapping one (in the card or the notification) fires the crow_messenger_action event with who tapped it.
